newsitem.title: USA: METAL MANAGEMENT SETS HOUSTON ACQUISITION.
newsitem.headline: METAL MANAGEMENT SETS HOUSTON ACQUISITION.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Friday it agreed to acquire Houston Compressed Steel Corp, a Houston, Texas-based company which dismantles steel mills and chemical plants and has estimated annualized gross revenues of $15 million.
The transaction will be structured as a tax-free merger.

The shareholders of Houston Compressed will receive 310,345 shares of Metal Management common stock subject to an adjustment based on the closing price of Metal Management stock on the day the transaction closes.

Jack Segal, president of Houston Compressed, and his son, Howard, vice president and general manager, will enter into multi-year employment agreements to work at Proler Southwest, following its merger with Metal Management. Houston Compressed will be consolidated under the Proler Southwest name along with Metal Management's other Houston operation, HouTex Metals Inc. Proler Southwest is a unit of Metal Management.
Closing of the proposed transaction requires, among other approvals, reaching a definitive merger agreement and completing due diligence.
Metal Management has said it plans to grow through acquisition in the consolidating scrap metal recycling industry.
